title: The Great Blanket Fort Revival
skyStory: Last quarter moon, thirty-seven percent lit, curled up in Cancer like a crab under a beach towel. She has decided the whole week deserves a blanket fort. The Little Dipper is propping up one corner. A passing comet has been asked to hold the flashlight. Saturn grumbles that it is structurally unsound. Saturn has also crawled inside.

reading: Friday energy meets Cancer cosiness, and the result is a strong urge to cancel everything and nest. You do not have to cancel everything. But you can cancel one thing, the least important one, and spend that hour somewhere soft.

In the evening, someone will tell you a long story about their week, and halfway through you will want to jump in with advice. Hold it. Just listen. Cancer moons reward the listener. The [[Queen of Cups]] sits beside you on the couch, nodding along, and she is a very good example to follow.
joel.mission: Listen to someone's whole story today without offering a single piece of advice, then ask one curious question.
joel.omen: A porch light left on in broad daylight. Somebody is guarding a quiet corner, and today that somebody should be you.

reading: Cancer moons pull at the tides and at memory. Somewhere today you will smell a smell from a long time ago, a particular soap, a kitchen, a rain-soaked wool sweater, and for one second you will be somewhere else entirely. Enjoy the trip. Come back with a story.

Tell that story to Joel later, with all the details your Wood Rat memory can supply. He will love it. The shore is in a nostalgic mood this week, leaving shells and sea glass where you happen to walk, and the [[Six of Cups]] holds out a flower from long ago like it was yesterday.
nancy.mission: Pick up one shell, stone or piece of sea glass today and keep it on your desk as a pocket souvenir.
nancy.omen: A scent that pulls you straight into a memory. A good old feeling is coming back to stay a while.

together.text: Build a blanket fort, even a tiny one over a chair, and send each other a photo from inside it. Rate the forts on comfort, structure and dramatic lighting. The moon will act as judge, and she has never seen a fort she did not love.

game.intro: Blanket fort revival night. The structural engineer is Saturn and he is not impressed. Give us the soundtrack.
game.prompt: A blanket fort collapsing politely, one cushion at a time.
